follow-up time: 1 year before conception to 1 year postpartum
cohort: Pregnant women with AIH reviewed at the autoimmune liver disease clinic at the Queen Elizabeth Hospital Birmingham between 2009 and 2020
finding: Pregnant women with AIH experience biochemical and immunological remission during pregnancy, but postpartum flare is common, with type 2 AIH potentially associated with a higher risk of both premature birth and postpartum flare.
